description:
Add a small spec that asserts the public API surface we depend on callers (src/fetcher.cr, software/*, youtube, json_feed, rss, reddit) uses remains stable:
- Fetcher::CrestHttpClient.new(config, validator)
- .build_headers(::HTTP::Headers)
- .with_cache(::HTTP::Headers, String?, String?)
- .clear_rate_limiters
- .clear_dns_cache
- .dns_max_entries / .dns_max_entries=
- #head, #get
- #clear_dns_cache

This gives the refactor guard rails so call sites don't silently break.
title: Add public-API regression test for CrestHttpClient
